clips.title: The story
paras: Gaxim Rustfizzle sends you back to Kaela Shadowspear with letters taken from the Venture Company. Their contents help the Sentinels follow the goblin cartel's work in Stonetalon.

Gaxim Rustfizzle sends you back to Kaela Shadowspear with captured letters. After you helped the gnome mage uncover Venture Company movements, he gathered correspondence detailing the cartel's operations. Kaela, a night elf Sentinel coordinator near Windshear Crag, is waiting for the letters. Gaxim also wants you to mention how his magic helped the investigation.

The Sentinels watch Stonetalon's crags with concern. Horde forces contest the lower trails, while the Venture Company cuts trees and mines the land. Its letters give Kaela a look at the cartel's communications and help the Alliance plan its defenses along the ridges.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, take these letters to Kaela. I'm sure she'll want to know about this. Or at least the Sentinels will.
Make sure you tell her how successful we were and how we couldn't have done it without a little bit of magic.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, friend? What can I do for you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You and Gaxim have done very well, friend. Thank you.
